Dash total block reward is now ~1.553 DASH (as of ~May 2026), not 2.31. Dash reduces ~7.14% every 210,240 blocks (~383 days), so 2.31 is several reduction periods old. Total reward split 45% miner / 45% masternode / 10% treasury.
150s (2.5 min) is the Dash protocol target block time. Unchanged.
6.25 LTC is correct for the era after the Aug 2023 halving. Next halving ~Jul/Sep 2027 -> 3.125. Current.
150s (2.5 min) is the Litecoin protocol target block time. Unchanged.

ZEC block reward halved 3.125 -> 1.5625 on 18 Nov 2024 (block 2,726,400, NU6). 2.5 was never an exact halving value and is stale; current subsidy is 1.5625 ZEC/block. Next halving ~late 2028 -> 0.78125.
75s block target (post-Blossom) is correct. Unchanged.
2^32 = 4294967296 is the fixed PoW difficulty-to-hashes relationship for SHA-256-family chains. Mathematical constant, not subject to change.
546 sats is the canonical Bitcoin Core dust threshold for a standard legacy P2PKH output at the default 3000 sat/kB dust-relay-fee. Unchanged default; used here only as a preset input.

ERGO block reward STALE: 27 is a long-outdated emission step. Reward stepped 9 -> 6 ERG on 3 Jan 2026 and reached the final 3 ERG tail/floor on 3 Apr 2026; as of Jun 2026 it is 3 ERG/block (ergo.watch shows current reward = 3). blockTime 120s is correct/unchanged.

ETC block reward STALE: current era is 2.048 ETC (after the 4th '5M20' reduction), not 2.56. 2.56 was the prior era. The 5th reduction ('Fifthening', block 25,000,001) to 1.6384 is expected ~Jul-Oct 2026 and has NOT happened as of Jun 2026, so 2.048 is current. blockTime ~13s correct/unchanged.

FLUX block reward STALE: Flux halved on 6 Aug 2025, cutting the total block reward 37.5 -> 18.75 FLUX/block. As of Jun 2026 the total is 18.75 (miner portion ~9.375 since ~50% goes to nodes). blockTime 120s correct/unchanged. (If the field is meant to be the miner-only share rather than total, 37.5 was already wrong on both readings post-Aug-2025.)

KAS block reward STALE: Kaspa's chromatic phase reduces the reward smoothly every month by (1/2)^(1/12). As of ~Jun 2026 the reward is ~55 KAS/block, far below the ledger's 200 (200 corresponds to a much earlier date). blockTime 1s (1 block/sec) correct/unchanged. Note value drifts monthly, so any hardcoded figure decays.

RVN block reward STALE: Ravencoin's 2nd halving hit block 4,200,000 on 15 Jan 2026, cutting 2500 -> 1250 RVN/block. As of Jun 2026 explorers show 1250. blockTime 60s correct/unchanged. Next halving ~2030 -> 625.
3.125 BTC/block is correct post-4th-halving (Apr 2024), paired with 144 blocks/day. The 1.5625/0.78125 future-subsidy constants in the same model are the correct upcoming halving values. Current.
US federal estate tax top rate is 40% (IRC §2001(c)); unchanged for 2026. A 40% default input value is correct.

Disclaimer hardcodes $12.92M (the 2023 exemption). The 2026 basic exclusion amount is $15,000,000 per OBBBA (made permanent, up from $13.99M in 2025). Confirmed stale; correct 2026 value is $15M (note: even the ledger's own 'correct' reference of $13.99M is the 2025 figure, not 2026).

Ledger has $13,990,000, which is the 2025 basic exclusion amount. For decedents dying in 2026 the exclusion is $15,000,000: OBBBA (signed Jul 2025) replaced the TCJA sunset with a permanent $15M base effective 2026-01-01, indexed from 2027. The TCJA-sunset note in the code is obsolete (no sunset occurred).
Flat top federal estate tax rate is 40% (IRC §2001(c)); unchanged for 2026. Step-up in basis to FMV at death (IRC §1014) also correct.

Rates (12/22/24/32/35/37 short-term; 0/15/20 long-term) are correct, but the bracket-edge dollar amounts are the 2025 single-filer thresholds, not 2026. Correct 2026 single-filer ordinary thresholds: 12% to $50,400, 22% to $105,700, 24% to $201,775, 32% to $256,225, 35% to $640,600, 37% above (Rev. Proc. 2025-32, confirmed via IRS newsroom + Tax Foundation). Top-bracket 37% threshold $626,351 should be $640,601.
Holding period for long-term treatment is more than 1 year (>1yr long-term, <=1yr short-term). Unchanged statutory rule (IRC §1222). Crypto taxed as property (Notice 2014-21). Correct.
Net Investment Income Tax is 3.8% (IRC §1411) on net investment income when MAGI exceeds $200,000 (single); rate and $200k threshold are statutory and not inflation-indexed, unchanged for 2026.
$3,000/year capital-loss deduction against ordinary income ($1,500 MFS) per IRC §1211(b); not indexed for inflation, unchanged since 1978. Correct for 2026.

Preset is the list of ordinary marginal rates [12,22,24,32,35,37], with no dollar thresholds attached. The 2026 marginal-rate set is 10/12/22/24/32/35/37%; the six pills shown (omitting the 10% bracket as user-selectable presets) are all valid current rates. Correct.

Wash-sale window is +/-30 days (IRC §1091). As of mid-2026 crypto remains EXEMPT from the wash-sale rule because digital assets are classified as property, not stock/securities; no legislation extending §1091 to digital assets has passed. The 30-day value and the code's 'crypto not subject to wash-sale' note are both current. (Legislative risk noted but not enacted.)
144 blocks/day x 3.125 BTC = 450 BTC/day. bitcoinblockhalf.com explicitly states current daily generation is 450 BTC and will drop to 225 after the next halving. Correct.
144 blocks/day = 86400s / 600s target block time. Confirmed as the standard derived figure on block-reward/explorer sources.
3.125 BTC is the current block subsidy after the 4th halving at block 840,000 (Apr 20 2024, 6.25 -> 3.125). Correct as of 2026-06.
5th halving at block 1,050,000 (840,000 + 210,000). Deterministic consensus fact, confirmed by all sources. Calendar ETA ~Apr 2028 is an estimate but the block height is fixed.
3.125 / 2 = 1.5625 BTC after the 5th halving. Confirmed by bitcoinblockhalf.com and multiple halving-schedule sources.
840,000 is the 4th-halving (anchor) block height. Confirmed historical fact.
Block 840,000 was mined 2024-04-20 (UTC), the 4th halving. Fixed historical event date. Correct.
600 s (~10 min) is the protocol target inter-block time; difficulty retargets every 2016 blocks to hold it. Basis for 144 blocks/day. Correct.
3.125 BTC current subsidy (post-840,000). Same as CURRENT_REWARD; consistent. Correct.
86400 = seconds/day, a fixed time constant in the canonical PoW expected-reward formula dailyBtc = (hashrate*86400*reward)/(difficulty*2^32). Trivially correct.

32 ETH remains the validator activation minimum after Pectra (May 2025). EIP-7251 raised the MAX effective balance to 2048 ETH but left the 32 ETH activation floor unchanged. As a contextual reference 32 is still correct.
2000 AVAX remains the Avalanche primary-network validator minimum (delegation minimum 25 AVAX). Unchanged consensus/protocol parameter.

32 ETH is the consensus-defined effective balance to activate a full validator (deposit-contract minimum). Pectra/EIP-7251 raised the cap to 2048 ETH but the 32 ETH activation floor is intact. Correct.

Australia has no inheritance/estate/death duty (abolished federally 1979). Rate 0 / exemption 0 is correct. CGT can apply on later disposal of inherited assets, with cost base generally inherited from the deceased (no general step-up). Ledger is accurate.

ITCMD is a state-level tax on inheritance/gifts, capped at 8% (Senate Resolution 9/1992) and varying 0-8% by state. No federal inheritance tax. Ledger's flat 8% is the legal maximum and a defensible conservative default; actual rate depends on state. Acceptable as 'current'.

Canada has no inheritance/estate tax. Instead there is a deemed disposition at death: the estate realizes capital gains on unrealized appreciation, taxed at the deceased's marginal rate via the final return. Rate 0 / exemption 0 for an inheritance tax is correct.

India abolished estate duty in 1985; no tax on receiving an inheritance. Rate 0 / exemption 0 correct. On later disposal of inherited VDAs the 30% flat tax (s.115BBH) applies; cost basis carries over from the deceased. Ledger is accurate.

Statutory basic exemption is JPY 30,000,000 + JPY 6,000,000 per statutory heir (unchanged for 2025/2026). The stored base+per_heir constants are correct. Caveat noted in ledger: code adds only ONE 6M increment rather than multiplying by actual heir count — that is an implementation detail, but the constant values themselves are current.

Rates 10/15/20/30/40/45/55 and the lower thresholds are correct, BUT the ledger is MISSING the 50% bracket for JPY 300M-600M and applies 55% from JPY 300M instead of from JPY 600M. Official ladder: ...45% on 200M-300M, 50% on 300M-600M, 55% above 600M. Overstates tax in the 300M-600M band.

2025-26 resident rates confirmed: 0% to $18,200; 16% $18,201-45,000; 30% $45,001-135,000; 37% $135,001-190,000; 45% $190,001+ (Stage 3 cuts, effective 2024-07-01, unchanged for 2025-26). Long-term = half (50% CGT discount): 8/15/18.5/22.5% correct. Rates exclude the 2% Medicare levy. Note: from 2026-07-01 the 16% bracket drops to 15% (future FY).
50% CGT discount for individuals on assets (incl. crypto) held at least 12 months, acquired on/after 21 Sep 1999. Confirmed by ATO/PwC. '12 months' threshold and the half-rate derivation are correct.

official_value: progressive 15%-22.5% (with R$35,000/month de minimis exemption still in force)

The PRIOR regime remains in force for 2026: progressive 15%-22.5% capital-gains rates with the R$35,000/month exemption for small disposals. Ledger's 17.5% flat (and 'no exemption') is NOT enacted law. Hint '2026 reform' is wrong.

official_value: 50% inclusion rate on ALL capital gains (no 66.67% tier)

The 'above_250k_from_2026: 66.67' tier is STALE/incorrect. The proposed two-thirds inclusion rate was cancelled 21 Mar 2025 and never enacted; CRA reverted to administering the 50% rate. Only {standard: 50} is correct; the above_250k_from_2026 and threshold_cad fields should be dropped.

Flat 30% on VDA gains under s.115BBH + 4% health & education cess (=31.2% base, more with surcharge), no deduction except cost of acquisition, no loss set-off or carry-forward, no holding-period distinction. All confirmed current for FY2025-26/AY2026-27.

1% TDS under s.194S and 4% cess on the 30% (=31.2% effective base) confirmed. TDS threshold: ledger uses INR 10,000, which is the standard-payer threshold (the higher INR 50,000/year threshold applies only to 'specified persons' — small/individual non-business payers). The 10,000 default is correct for the general case.

For 2026 crypto remains MISCELLANEOUS INCOME taxed at progressive national rates (5-45%) plus 10% local inhabitant tax = combined 15-55%, matching the ledger ladder. The flat 20% reform is only a PROPOSAL in the 2026 Tax Reform Outline (released 19 Dec 2025), pending Diet legislation and limited to 'specified crypto assets'; individual implementation projected ~2027/2028. NOT enacted for 2026 — progressive treatment is current.

JPY 200,000 filing exemption applies to a salaried person whose total non-employment (incl. misc/crypto) income for the year does not exceed JPY 200,000 (national income tax). Note it does not exempt the 10% local inhabitant tax. Threshold value is current.

WRONG amount. The crypto basic deduction is KRW 2,500,000/year (only gains above KRW 2.5M are taxed), NOT KRW 50,000,000. KRW 50M is the deduction for domestic LISTED STOCKS — a different regime; the ~20x gap is a well-known point of public contention. Also note the tax itself is not yet in force (starts 1 Jan 2027). Replace 50,000,000 with 2,500,000.

22% (20% national 'other income' + 2% local) is the confirmed rate, taking effect 1 Jan 2027 (delayed from 2025; Finance Ministry reaffirmed Nov 2025 it proceeds as scheduled, though repeal/abolition bills are pending). Rate is correct; hint 'delayed to 2027' is accurate. No crypto gains tax is enforced in 2026.
ErbStG §16 personal allowances unchanged for 2026: spouse €500,000, child €400,000, Steuerklasse III/unrelated €20,000. Matches input.

Class I bands 7/11/15/19/23/27/30% by taxable value are correct per ErbStG §19 (unchanged 2026). BUT the 'other_unrelated' (Steuerklasse III) breakpoint between 30% and 50% is officially €6,000,000, not the €600,000 shown in the input — likely an error/simplification in the config; cannot confirm the €600,000 cutoff against law.
IHT nil-rate band remains £325,000; frozen (Autumn Budget 2024 to 2029/30, extended by Budget 2025 to 2030/31). Current for 2026/27.
Standard IHT rate 40% above the nil-rate band. Unchanged for 2026/27.

Austria flat 27.5% (KESt / Sondersteuersatz) on crypto gains (Neubestand, acquired after 28 Feb 2021) unchanged for 2026; crypto-to-crypto swaps not taxed; Altbestand (pre-1 Mar 2021) generally exempt.
Private investors pay 0% capital gains tax on crypto (Art. 16(3) DBG); unchanged for 2026. Professional traders taxed as income; wealth tax applies separately.
Cantonal wealth tax roughly 0.1%-1% per year (e.g. ~0.1% Nidwalden to ~1% Geneva); input range 0.15-1.0% is within the accepted ballpark. Cantonal, no single official figure; current.

2026 §32a EStG: Grundfreibetrag rose to €12,348 (input €12,084 is the prior-year value) and the 42% zone starts at €69,879 (input bracket boundary €68,430 is outdated). 45% (Reichensteuer) threshold €277,826 is correct. Long-term 0% (>1yr tax-free) still correct.
Germany §23 EStG: crypto held >1 year is tax-free; 1-year Spekulationsfrist unchanged for 2026. Short-term (<1yr) taxed at personal income rate.
€1,000 Freigrenze for private-sale (§23) gains, raised from €600 effective 2024, remains €1,000 for 2026. It is a Freigrenze (whole gain taxable once exceeded), as the input notes.
Spain savings-income (base del ahorro) bands 19/21/23/27/30% unchanged for 2026 (19% ≤0-6k, 21% 6k-50k, 23% 50k-200k, 27% 200k-300k, 30% >300k). Matches input.
France €305 annual disposal de-minimis (on total proceeds/cessions, CGI art. 150 VH bis) unchanged for 2026. Matches input.
PFU rose from 30% to 31.4% effective 1 Jan 2026 via PLFSS 2026 (CSG raised, social contributions 12.8% IR + 18.6% social). Input 30% is the 2025 value; 2026 value is 31.4%.

Italy crypto substitute tax rises from 26% to 33% effective 1 Jan 2026 (Legge di Bilancio 2026 / 2025 Budget Law); the €2,000 exemption is abolished from 2026. Input 26% is the through-2025 value. (Note: 26% retained only for MiCA EMT euro stablecoins.)
Box 3 heffingvrij vermogen for 2026 is €59,357 per person (€118,714 for partners) per Belastingdienst. Input €57,684 is the 2025 figure.

Poland flat 19% tax on crypto-to-fiat gains (PIT-38) unchanged for 2026; crypto-to-crypto swaps tax-neutral; acquisition costs deductible. Matches input.
Portugal (Cat. G): crypto held ≥365 days exempt; <365 days taxed at flat 28%. 365-day rule unchanged for 2026. Crypto-to-crypto not taxed. Matches input.
Portugal short-term (<365 days) crypto gains flat 28% (Cat. G optional autonomous rate); long-term 0%. Unchanged for 2026. Matches input.
UK CGT on crypto 18% basic / 24% higher (from 30 Oct 2024 Budget) unchanged for 2025/26 and 2026/27; basic-rate band £37,700, additional rate above £125,140. Matches input.
CGT Annual Exempt Amount £3,000, applies to 2024/25, 2025/26 and 2026/27. Matches input.
